critical_code_review_comments: useTradeMarkers.js: tooltip only triggers when crosshair time exactly equals bar-aligned toBar(opened_at). For very recent trades on the live forming bar, some users may hover 1-2 pixels off; consider matching within +/- barSec to make tooltip more discoverable (currently robust once mouse crosses the exact bar column).

MainChart.js line 234 crosshair handler is registered with an empty dependency array; tradeMapRef.current is used via ref so this is fine, but the chart handle chartRef.current may be null at first mount - handler correctly early-returns via `if (!chart)`, no bug.
backend history endpoint returns 721 candles for days=30 at 1h (expected 720) - fencepost includes the currently-forming candle; harmless but worth noting the ~ range in docs.

useTradeMarkers polls every 30s via setInterval; for a page with the chart hidden (background tab), this still fires. Consider clearing interval on visibilitychange if the app has many charts. Not a blocker.
